footnote_text: These shares were acquired under the Issuer's 2020 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (the "ESPP") in a transaction that was exempt under both Rule 16b-3(d) and Rule 16b-3(c). In accordance with the ESPP, these shares were purchased at a price equal to 85% of the lesser of the closing price of the Issuer's common stock on the Offering Date and on the Purchase Date (each as defined in the ESPP).
